  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_17(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  size_t i = 0;\n  size_t cnt = 0;\n  size_t total = 0;\n  size_t c;\n\n  while (1) {\n    if ((len <= i) || (in[i] == 0)) {\n      if (out_cap < cnt) {\n        return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n      } else {\n        for (c = 0; c < cnt; c++) {\n          out[c] = in[i];\n          i = i + in[i + 1] + 2;\n        }\n        return (uint64_t)(cnt << 0x20) | total;\n      }\n    }\n    if ((len < i + 2) || (len < i + in[i + 1] + 2)) break;\n    total += in[i + 1];\n    cnt++;\n    i += in[i + 1] + 2;\n  }\n  return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n}"
